description: Sentences bound to the properties that draw their value on the elements that have them (`DRAWN_ON`): an `<a>`'s and an `<option>`'s `text`, a `<textarea>`'s and an `<output>`'s `value` and `defaultValue`, an `<iframe>`'s `srcdoc`, and the `defaultValue` of a search field, which writes the `value` it shows (measured: Angular 22.2.1 sets each, and Chromium 152 draws each). An `<option>`'s `value` and a checkbox's draw nothing, and the reference holds them; read off any element, a property of these names refused them, and read nowhere, it passed all eight.
